does: Fries an egg in a good depth of very hot oil, spooning the oil over, so that the white puffs with brown, lacy, crisp edges and the yolk stays runny.
how: Heat a good depth of oil in a wok until it shimmers.
Crack the egg into a small bowl, then slide it into the oil.
Spoon hot oil over the white as it puffs and bubbles.
Lift it out when the edges are brown and crisp and the yolk is still soft, and drain it.

cues.text: A puffed white with brown, lacy edges around a glossy yolk.

mistakes.mistake: Using too little oil or a cool wok, which gives a flat, pale egg.
mistakes.fix: Use plenty of oil and heat it well first.

mistakes.mistake: Cracking the egg straight from the shell over hot oil.
mistakes.fix: Crack it into a small bowl first and slide it in, standing back.

variant_of.differs: A good depth of very hot oil makes the white puff and crisp at the edges.
